theorems.name: Submission.dr_cc_radial_map
theorems.statement: ∀ (D : ℕ) (a : Eucl D), (∀ i, 1 / 4 < a i ∧ a i < 3 / 4) → ∀ (J : Finset (Fin D)) (c : Eucl D), (∀ i ∈ J, c i = a i) → ∃ g : Eucl D → Eucl D, ∀ x : Eucl D, (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → (∀ i ∉ J, x i = c i) → x ≠ c → (∀ i, 0 ≤ g x i ∧ g x i ≤ 1) ∧ (∃ i ∈ J, g x i = 0 ∨ g x i = 1) ∧ ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ (∀ i, g x i - c i = s * (x i - c i)) ∧ s * dist x c ≤ Real.sqrt (D : ℝ) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' : Eucl D, (∀ i, 0 ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ 1) → (∀ i ∉ J, x' i = c i) → dist x' x < δ → dist (g x') (g x) ≤ ((1 + 4 * Real.sqrt (D : ℝ)) * s + ε) * dist x' x
